title: Kernel of restriction to a hyperplane
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$, and let $\beta:V\to\mathbb F_2$ be a nonzero linear functional. The kernel of the restriction map from linear functionals on $V$ to linear functionals on $\ker\beta$ is the one-dimensional span of $\beta$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$
$\beta$ is a nonzero linear functional on $V$
